subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped Claw schema and gated core CLI as the base contract for RFC 0016?
rationale: The open RFC proposes a new core package lifecycle across eleven dependent PRs, so code correctness cannot determine whether these permanent product and compatibility surfaces belong in core.

options.title: Adopt after consolidation
options.body: Approve the grouped contract after the duplicate parsers are removed, then review dependent lifecycle PRs against this canonical base.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Keep this PR and the dependent stack paused while the schema, ownership, or CLI boundary is narrowed.

options.title: Reject core Claws
options.body: Close the implementation stack if maintainers do not want this package lifecycle in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Adopt after consolidation
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped contract after the duplicate parsers are removed, then review dependent lifecycle PRs against this canonical base.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available decision owner because he already made the concrete product-model and schema request on the linked RFC.
